name: Practical Video Denoising Benchmark
description: A dataset and evaluation suite for assessing video denoising performance across practical, real-world scenarios and a baseline network.
reputation: A practical academic benchmark for real-world video denoising research but not a broadly adopted community standard.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on real noisy videos; dataset may be limited in size and domain diversity. Common metrics (PSNR/SSIM) do not always reflect perceptual quality.
